messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

The relation 'has pediatric maximum dose' in the triplet is defined as 'The highest dose at which the subject drug can be administered to children aged 12 and older is specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
B. 'has strength': The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
C. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
